كِظَاظٌ : see 3, of which it is an inf. n. ―
-b2- Also, (assumed tropical:) Difficulty, or distress, and fatigue, (K, TA,) in an affair, such as takes away the breath. (TA.) And (assumed tropical:) Grief, or disquietude, or anxiety, occasioned by war, filling the heart. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
